cards.title: States & UTs Mapped
cards.description: Every jurisdiction kept as its own record, not folded into a national feed.

cards.title: Four States, Most of the Story
cards.description: Karnataka, Delhi, Maharashtra and Telangana carry 60% of every state-level signal. Fourteen states register fewer than fifteen. The map is four deep markets and a long, thin tail.

cards.title: Capital Runs Barbell
cards.description: One round — Neysa's $1.2B — is 47% of all capital tracked. The median deal is $5.5M. India funds a great many small companies and very few large ones.

cards.title: Policy Moves in Waves
cards.description: 44% of every policy move logged landed in the two months around the AI Impact Summit. By May it had fallen to eight. Attention here is event-driven, not continuous.

cards.title: Three Outlets, Two-Fifths
cards.description: Three publications carry 40% of India's AI coverage. The state-level story lives in the other 74 — which is why we read all of them.

heading: NINE MONTHS OF SIGNAL
subheading: Every AI signal out of India — 2,032 of them — read, filed and cross-checked since January 2026.
